dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: This trip has been great! No bad luck or big issues, just lots of fun and great food...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: And the best part is, I've met a bunch of great new friends.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Hehe, I can't wait to tell my dads all about it. They'll be so surprised!

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Professor, I think I get it now...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: Your poem. The eternal light falling from the heavens... That wasn't meant to be starlight at all, was it?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Shh... Just feel it in your heart. A poem isn't so much a question with an answer... as a passing gust of wind. As long as you feel it, it'll always be with you.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: I see... Well, I really appreciate everything you've done for me, Professor.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Keep the poems coming, Bennett! I look forward to hearing even more of your work in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #Thanks for coming on this adventure with me, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Sunny islands, crackling bonfires, exciting attractions, carefree parties...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: If I didn't know better, I'd say it was all a dream.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: But knowing it was all real, I'm starting to feel emotional again.. Haha, this must be true happiness, huh?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Not only did I finally meet the people dearest to me, but together with my closest friends, I spent a summer I wish could have lasted forever...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I really am the luckiest person in the world.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I picked out gifts for my dads and everyone back in Mondstadt. I was convinced my bag would be big enough, but I ended up having to buy another one just to squeeze everything in...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I also picked up a bottle of concentrated honeydew. When I get back, I'm planning to ask Diona to create a Dandelion-flavored drink for Professor Venti with it.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Wait a sec... Diona? Oh no, but what about Draff! How could I have forgotten Draff? Guess I'll be making another trip to the market, then...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh, those guys! To tell you the truth, I was really worried when Mr. Ifa first asked for my help. As I told him, I could never hope to pull off Mona's whole hydromancy thing, and I'd no doubt cause trouble if I even tried...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: But then he said, "as long as you can wave a stick around, we're good, bro," and told me he'd handle the rest.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I heard things got really lively afterwards. I'm happy for them, and for Cacucu too!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Safe travels to you too! I'll be looking forward to the day we bump into each other again on another adventure.
